SaaS Anywhere transforms enterprise cloud defense by fusing automated AWS telemetry ingestion with intelligent, AI-driven threat triage. Designed natively for multi-account cloud topologies, the platform bridges the gap between raw security data and immediate, automated response workflows, dramatically reducing manual overhead for security teams.

Leveraging secure cross-account Bring Your Own AWS Account (BYOA) IAM roles and Amazon EventBridge integration, the platform seamlessly centralizes insights from Amazon GuardDuty and AWS Security Hub. Organizations gain real-time visibility, continuous compliance tracking, and robust threat remediation capabilities without compromising architectural control or data sovereignty.

### Highlights

- AI-driven threat remediation that automates security triage and incident response across complex multi-account AWS architectures.

- Native integration with Amazon GuardDuty and AWS Security Hub to centralize real-time telemetry and compliance insights.

- Secure Bring Your Own AWS Account (BYOA) deployment via automated CloudFormation provisioning with strict least-privilege IAM controls.
